raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Summary - Add an AMD MiniMax-M3.1 compatibility path modeled on SGLang: consume the official `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` NVFP4 checkpoint, requantize routed experts NVFP4→MXFP4 at load (`--quantization-config.moe mxfp4`), and keep the supported ROCm FP8 MSA/indexer caches. - Wire nested DSpark from `{model}/dspark` (`DSparkMiniMaxDraftModel`), skip draft tensors on the target load, route all 60 MSA layers, and fail early with a precise recipe if NVFP4 KV/indexer is requested on ROCm. - Update the public MI355 recipe so it no longer claims native NVFP4 KV + MXFP8 experts. Default AMD serving is MXFP4 experts + FP8 KV/indexer; monokernel and DBO stay off until proven on the all-sparse M3.1 layout. **Served precision to claim:** official NVFP4 checkpoint requantized to MXFP4 routed experts with FP8 main KV and FP8 indexer. This is not native NVFP4 serving. ## Reproducibility ```bash # image: vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly (or the branch built from this PR) # checkpoint: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash bash examples/online_serving/minimax_m31_flash_rocm.sh ``` TP4 MI350/MI355 AgentX sweep wrapper: ```bash ACCOUNT=amd-agentx QOS=amd-agentx-4-qos PARTITION=amd-spur \ bash examples/online_serving/minimax_m31_flash_rocm_qos.sh submit ``` ## Tests - CPU: `tests/models/test_minimax_m31_amd_compat.py` — all-sparse MSA config, nested DSpark path/architecture, weight mapper, NVFP4→MXFP4 layout (scales, packing, AITER padding, gate/up split), NVFP4 recipe guards. - ROCm dispatch (Unix/vLLM env): `tests/kernels/attention/test_minimax_m31_rocm_dispatch.py` — reject NVFP4 KV/indexer; FP8 is not treated as NVFP4. Local result from this change: 16 CPU tests passed. The ROCm dispatch module is skipped on Windows (`uvloop`). AgentX TP4 QOS (c1/c4/c8/c16/c32/c64), accuracy vs a non-requantized reference, long-context, and memory sweeps were not run from this workstation (no MI350X/MI355X allocation / `srun`). The scripts above are the exact commands for that QOS job. ## Test plan - [ ] `pytest tests/models/test_minimax_m31_amd_compat.py tests/kernels/attention/test_minimax_m31_rocm_dispatch.py` - [ ] Load `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` on MI355X TP4 with the recipe above; confirm generation smoke - [ ] Confirm `--kv-cache-dtype nvfp4` / `indexer_kv_dtype=nvfp4` fails with the MXFP4+FP8 recipe message - [ ] AgentX TP4 sweep c1,c4,c8,c16,c32,c64 with nested DSpark; publish only MXFP4 experts + FP8 KV/indexer - [ ] Long-context and memory comparison vs the previous MXFP8-requant / NVFP4-KV recipe - [ ] Do not enable `--compilation-config.monokernel` or DBO until separately proven on this layout --- Need help on this PR? +# MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on AMD
+
+`minimax_m31_flash_rocm.sh` is the TP4 MI350/MI355 recipe:
+
+- Official `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` checkpoint
+- Routed experts requantized NVFP4→MXFP4 at load (`--quantization-config.moe mxfp4`)
+- FP8 main KV and FP8 indexer (`--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, `indexer_kv_dtype=fp8`)
+- Nested DSpark draft from `{model}/dspark`
+- Block size 128
+- Monokernel and dual-batch overlap left off
+
+Published numbers must name that served precision. This is not native NVFP4.
+
+`minimax_m31_flash_rocm_qos.sh` wraps the recipe for an `amd-agentx-4-qos` TP4
+allocation. It runs:
+
+1. model-load / generation smoke
+2. long-context indexer/KV check
+3. Prometheus memory snapshot
+4. AgentX concurrencies `c1,c4,c8,c16,c32,c64` with fixed DSpark settings
+5. optional accuracy compare when `REFERENCE_URL` points at a reference server
+
+`minimax_m31_flash_rocm_validate.py` is the smoke / long-context / metrics helper.
+
+```bash
+# local node that already has 4x MI350/MI355
+bash examples/online_serving/minimax_m31_flash_rocm_qos.sh local
+
+# Slurm
+ACCOUNT=amd-agentx QOS=amd-agentx-4-qos PARTITION=amd-spur \
+  bash examples/online_serving/minimax_m31_flash_rocm_qos.sh submit
+```

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# MiniMax-M3.1-Flash TP4 serving recipe for AMD MI350X/MI355X.
+#
+# Precision actually served:
+#   official NVFP4 checkpoint, routed experts requantized NVFP4→MXFP4 at load,
+#   FP8 main KV + FP8 indexer. This is not native NVFP4 serving.
+#
+# Do not enable monokernel (--compilation-config.monokernel) or dual-batch
+# overlap for this model until they are proven on the all-sparse M3.1 layout.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+MODEL="${MODEL:-MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash}"
+TP="${TP:-4}"
+PORT="${PORT:-8000}"
+MAX_MODEL_LEN="${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-32768}"
+NUM_SPECULATIVE_TOKENS="${NUM_SPECULATIVE_TOKENS:-3}"
+GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION="${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.90}"
+
+export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER="${VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER:-1}"
+export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS="${VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS:-1}"
+
+exec vllm serve "${MODEL}" \
+  --tensor-parallel-size "${TP}" \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 \
+  --port "${PORT}" \
+  --trust-remote-code \
+  --block-size 128 \
+  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
+  --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "fp8"}' \
+  --quantization-config.moe mxfp4 \
+  --speculative-config "{\"method\": \"dspark\", \"num_speculative_tokens\": ${NUM_SPECULATIVE_TOKENS}, \"kv_cache_dtype\": \"fp8\", \"draft_sample_method\": \"probabilistic\"}" \
+  --gpu-memory-utilization "${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION}" \
+  --max-model-len "${MAX_MODEL_LEN}" \
+  --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
+  --tool-call-parser minimax_m3 \
+  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
+  "$@"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# QOS / AgentX sweep for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on amd-agentx-4-qos.
+#
+# Expected allocation: 1x MI350X/MI355X node, 4 GPUs (TP4).
+# Claim only MXFP4 experts + FP8 KV/indexer in published results.
+#
+# Stages:
+#   1. serve the official checkpoint with the AMD recipe
+#   2. model-load / generation smoke
+#   3. long-context indexer/KV check
+#   4. Prometheus memory snapshot
+#   5. AgentX TP4 concurrency sweep (c1 c4 c8 c16 c32 c64)
+#   6. optional accuracy compare against REFERENCE_URL
+set -euo pipefail
+
+ACCOUNT="${ACCOUNT:-amd-agentx}"
+QOS="${QOS:-amd-agentx-4-qos}"
+PARTITION="${PARTITION:-amd-spur}"
+TIME_LIMIT="${TIME_LIMIT:-4:00:00}"
+MODEL="${MODEL:-MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash}"
+CONCURRENCIES="${CONCURRENCIES:-1 4 8 16 32 64}"
+SERVER_PORT="${SERVER_PORT:-8000}"
+BENCHMARK_DURATION="${BENCHMARK_DURATION:-180}"
+LONG_CONTEXT_TOKENS="${LONG_CONTEXT_TOKENS:-8192}"
+OUTPUT_DIR="${OUTPUT_DIR:-./results/minimax-m31-flash-rocm}"
+IMAGE="${IMAGE:-}"
+REFERENCE_URL="${REFERENCE_URL:-}"
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+SERVE_SCRIPT="${SCRIPT_DIR}/minimax_m31_flash_rocm.sh"
+VALIDATE_SCRIPT="${SCRIPT_DIR}/minimax_m31_flash_rocm_validate.py"
+
+mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"
+
+log() {
+  printf '[minimax-m31-qos] %s\n' "$*"
+}
+
+write_summary_header() {
+  cat > "${OUTPUT_DIR}/SUMMARY.md" <<EOF
+# MiniMax-M3.1-Flash AMD QOS
+
+- Served precision: official NVFP4 checkpoint, routed experts requantized
+  NVFP4→MXFP4 at load, FP8 main KV + FP8 indexer.
+- Not native NVFP4 serving.
+- Model: \`${MODEL}\`
+- Recipe: \`${SERVE_SCRIPT}\`
+- Image: \`${IMAGE:-local}\`
+- Concurrencies: \`${CONCURRENCIES}\`
+- DSpark: nested \`{model}/dspark\`, \`num_speculative_tokens=3\`, block size 128
+- Monokernel / DBO: disabled
+
+EOF
+}
+
+run_validate() {
+  python3 "${VALIDATE_SCRIPT}" \
+    --base-url "http://127.0.0.1:${SERVER_PORT}/v1" \
+    --output "${OUTPUT_DIR}/validate.json" \
+    --long-context-tokens "${LONG_CONTEXT_TOKENS}"
+}
+
+run_accuracy() {
+  if [[ -z "${REFERENCE_URL}" ]]; then
+    log "REFERENCE_URL unset; recording this server's smoke as the candidate only."
+    return 0
+  fi
+  python3 - "${REFERENCE_URL}" "http://127.0.0.1:${SERVER_PORT}/v1" "${OUTPUT_DIR}/accuracy.json" <<'PY'
+import json, sys, urllib.request
+
+ref_base, cand_base, out = sys.argv[1:]
+prompt = "Write a one-sentence description of sparse mixture-of-experts routing."
+
+def complete(base):
+    payload = json.dumps({
+        "model": json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(base + "/models").read())["data"][0]["id"],
+        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
+        "max_tokens": 64,
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }).encode()
+    req = urllib.request.Request(
+        base + "/chat/completions",
+        data=payload,
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer EMPTY"},
+    )
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as resp:
+        body = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
+    return body["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+
+result = {
+    "served_precision": "mxfp4_experts_fp8_kv_indexer",
+    "prompt": prompt,
+    "reference": complete(ref_base.rstrip("/")),
+    "candidate": complete(cand_base.rstrip("/")),
+}
+result["exact_match"] = result["reference"] == result["candidate"]
+open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
+print("wrote", out, "exact_match", result["exact_match"])
+PY
+}
+
+run_agentx() {
+  local conc="$1"
+  local art="${OUTPUT_DIR}/c${conc}"
+  mkdir -p "${art}"
+  aiperf profile \
+    --scenario inferencex-agentx-mvp \
+    --url "http://127.0.0.1:${SERVER_PORT}" \
+    --endpoint /v1/chat/completions \
+    --endpoint-type chat \
+    --streaming \
+    --model "${MODEL}" \
+    --tokenizer "${MODEL}" \
+    --tokenizer-trust-remote-code \
+    --apply-chat-template \
+    --concurrency "${conc}" \
+    --benchmark-duration "${BENCHMARK_DURATION}" \
+    --random-seed 42 \
+    --failed-request-threshold 0.10 \
+    --use-server-token-count \
+    --no-gpu-telemetry \
+    --public-dataset semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126 \
+    --output-artifact-dir "${art}"
+}
+
+run_suite() {
+  write_summary_header
+  if [[ -n "${IMAGE}" ]]; then
+    log "Using container image: ${IMAGE}"
+  fi
+  log "Starting MiniMax-M3.1-Flash TP4 server (MXFP4 experts, FP8 KV/indexer)."
+  bash "${SERVE_SCRIPT}" --port "${SERVER_PORT}" &
+  local server_pid=$!
+  trap 'kill ${server_pid} 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
+  run_validate
+  run_accuracy
+  for conc in ${CONCURRENCIES}; do
+    log "AgentX concurrency=${conc}"
+    run_agentx "${conc}"
+  done
+  {
+    echo "## Artifacts"
+    echo
+    echo "- \`validate.json\`: smoke, long-context, memory metrics"
+    echo "- \`accuracy.json\`: optional reference comparison"
+    echo "- \`c{N}/\`: AgentX artifacts"
+    echo
+    echo "Publish only MXFP4 experts + FP8 KV/indexer. Do not claim native NVFP4."
+  } >> "${OUTPUT_DIR}/SUMMARY.md"
+  log "done. results in ${OUTPUT_DIR}"
+}
+
+submit_qos() {
+  local job="${OUTPUT_DIR}/qos.sbatch"
+  mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"
+  cat > "${job}" <<EOF
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../.."
+OUTPUT_DIR="${OUTPUT_DIR}" MODEL="${MODEL}" SERVER_PORT="${SERVER_PORT}" \\
+  CONCURRENCIES="${CONCURRENCIES}" BENCHMARK_DURATION="${BENCHMARK_DURATION}" \\
+  LONG_CONTEXT_TOKENS="${LONG_CONTEXT_TOKENS}" IMAGE="${IMAGE}" \\
+  REFERENCE_URL="${REFERENCE_URL}" \\
+  bash "${SCRIPT_DIR}/minimax_m31_flash_rocm_qos.sh" local
+EOF
+  sbatch \
+    --job-name minimax-m31-flash-tp4 \
+    --account "${ACCOUNT}" \
+    --qos "${QOS}" \
+    --partition "${PARTITION}" \
+    --time "${TIME_LIMIT}" \
+    --nodes=1 \
+    --ntasks=1 \
+    --gres=gpu:4 \
+    --output="${OUTPUT_DIR}/qos-%j.out" \
+    --error="${OUTPUT_DIR}/qos-%j.err" \
+    "${job}"
+}
+
+case "${1:-local}" in
+  submit)
+    submit_qos
+    ;;
+  local)
+    run_suite
+    ;;
+  *)
+    echo "Usage: $0 [local|submit]"
+    exit 1
+    ;;
+esac

+"""

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import time
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+from pathlib import Path
+
+DEFAULT_BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1"
+SERVED_PRECISION = "mxfp4_experts_fp8_kv_indexer"
+
+
+def _request(url: str, payload: dict | None = None, timeout: float = 120.0) -> dict:
+    data = None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
+    req = urllib.request.Request(
+        url,
+        data=data,
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer EMPTY"},
+        method="GET" if payload is None else "POST",
+    )
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
+        return json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+
+
+def wait_ready(base: str, timeout_s: float) -> str:
+    deadline = time.time() + timeout_s
+    last_error = "server did not become ready"
+    models_url = base.rstrip("/") + "/models"
+    while time.time() < deadline:
+        try:
+            body = _request(models_url, timeout=10)
+            model = body["data"][0]["id"]
+            print(f"ready model={model}")
+            return model
+        except (urllib.error.URLError, KeyError, IndexError) as exc:
+            last_error = str(exc)
+            time.sleep(5)
+    raise SystemExit(f"timeout waiting for {models_url}: {last_error}")
+
+
+def smoke(base: str, model: str) -> dict:
+    body = _request(
+        base.rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions",
+        {
+            "model": model,
+            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Say only: ok"}],
+            "max_tokens": 16,
+            "temperature": 0,
+        },
+    )
+    text = body["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    print(f"smoke={text!r}")
+    return {"text": text, "usage": body.get("usage", {})}
+
+
+def long_context(base: str, model: str, tokens: int) -> dict:
+    filler = "word " * tokens
+    prompt = (
+        f"The marker TOKEN_ALPHA appears once in this preamble.\n{filler}\n"
+        "Reply with only TOKEN_ALPHA."
+    )
+    body = _request(
+        base.rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions",
+        {
+            "model": model,
+            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
+            "max_tokens": 16,
+            "temperature": 0,
+        },
+        timeout=600,
+    )
+    text = body["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    print(f"long_context tokens~={tokens} text={text!r}")
+    return {"text": text, "usage": body.get("usage", {})}
+
+
+def metrics(metrics_url: str) -> str:
+    req = urllib.request.Request(metrics_url)
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
+            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
+    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
+        print(f"metrics unavailable: {exc}")
+        return ""
+    keep = [
+        line
+        for line in raw.splitlines()
+        if any(
+            key in line
+            for key in (
+                "vllm:kv_cache_usage",
+                "vllm:gpu_cache",
+                "vllm:num_requests",
+                "process_resident_memory_bytes",
+            )
+        )
+    ]
+    print("\n".join(keep[:40]))
+    return "\n".join(keep)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--base-url", default=os.environ.get("BASE_URL", DEFAULT_BASE))
+    parser.add_argument("--output", default="")
+    parser.add_argument("--wait-s", type=float, default=1800)
+    parser.add_argument("--long-context-tokens", type=int, default=8192)
+    parser.add_argument("--skip-long-context", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    model = wait_ready(args.base_url, args.wait_s)
+    result = {
+        "served_precision": SERVED_PRECISION,
+        "model": model,
+        "base_url": args.base_url,
+        "smoke": smoke(args.base_url, model),
+        "metrics": metrics(args.base_url.rstrip("/").removesuffix("/v1") + "/metrics"),
+    }
+    if not args.skip_long_context:
+        result["long_context"] = long_context(
+            args.base_url, model, args.long_context_tokens
+        )
+    if args.output:
+        path = Path(args.output)
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
+        print(f"wrote {path}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+def _quantize_e2m1(value: float) -> int:
+    sign = 8 if value < 0 else 0
+    mag = abs(value)
+    best = min(range(8), key=lambda code: abs(mag - _E2M1[code]))
+    return sign | best
+
+
+def _mxfp4_quantize_row(values: list[float]) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
+    packed: list[int] = []
+    scales: list[int] = []
+    for start in range(0, len(values), MXFP4_GROUP_SIZE):
+        block = values[start : start + MXFP4_GROUP_SIZE]
+        max_abs = max((abs(value) for value in block), default=0.0)
+        if max_abs == 0.0:
+            exp = 127
+        else:
+            import math
+
+            exp = int(math.floor(math.log2(max_abs / 6.0))) + 127
+            exp = min(max(exp, 0), 255)
+        scale = 2.0 ** (exp - 127)
+        scales.append(exp)
+        codes = [_quantize_e2m1(value / scale) for value in block]
+        for lo, hi in zip(codes[0::2], codes[1::2], strict=True):
+            packed.append(lo | (hi << 4))
+    return packed, scales
+
+
+def _mxfp4_dequantize_row(packed: list[int], scales: list[int]) -> list[float]:
+    out: list[float] = []
+    for group, exp in enumerate(scales):
+        scale = 2.0 ** (exp - 127)
+        for byte in packed[
+            group * (MXFP4_GROUP_SIZE // 2) : (group + 1) * (MXFP4_GROUP_SIZE // 2)
+        ]:
+            lo = byte & 0xF
+            hi = (byte >> 4) & 0xF
+            for nibble in (lo, hi):
+                mag = _E2M1[nibble & 7]
+                out.append((-mag if nibble & 8 else mag) * scale)
+    return out

+def _minimax_dspark_rotary_emb(config: Any, head_dim: int):

+    rope_scaling = getattr(config, "rope_scaling", None)

+class MiniMaxM3DSparkMLP(nn.Module):
+    """Dense SwiGLU-OAI MLP used by every MiniMax DSpark draft layer."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        intermediate_size: int,
+        *,
+        swiglu_limit: float,
+        swiglu_alpha: float,
+        swiglu_beta: float,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.gate_up_proj = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            [intermediate_size] * 2,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.gate_up_proj",
+        )
+        self.down_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            intermediate_size,
+            hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.down_proj",
+        )
+        self.act_fn = SiluAndMulWithClamp(
+            swiglu_limit=swiglu_limit,
+            alpha=swiglu_alpha,
+            beta=swiglu_beta,
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        gate_up, _ = self.gate_up_proj(x)
+        x = self.act_fn(gate_up)
+        x, _ = self.down_proj(x)

+class MiniMaxM3DSparkAttention(nn.Module):
+    """Dense GQA with MiniMax Gemma QK-norm and partial RoPE."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Any,
+        *,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+        sliding_window: int | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        self.total_num_heads = config.num_attention_heads
+        assert self.total_num_heads % tp_size == 0
+        self.num_heads = self.total_num_heads // tp_size
+        self.total_num_kv_heads = config.num_key_value_heads
+        if self.total_num_kv_heads >= tp_size:
+            assert self.total_num_kv_heads % tp_size == 0
+        else:
+            assert tp_size % self.total_num_kv_heads == 0
+        self.num_kv_heads = max(1, self.total_num_kv_heads // tp_size)
+        self.head_dim = config.head_dim
+        self.q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5
+        # MiniMax-M3.1 DSpark is non-causal; the DFlash mask supplies visibility.
+        self.causal = False
+        rms_eps = getattr(config, "rms_norm_eps", 1e-6)
+
+        self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.total_num_heads,
+            self.total_num_kv_heads,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+        )
+        self.o_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+            hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.o_proj",
+        )
+        self.q_norm = GemmaRMSNorm(self.head_dim, eps=rms_eps)
+        self.k_norm = GemmaRMSNorm(self.head_dim, eps=rms_eps)
+        self.rotary_emb = _minimax_dspark_rotary_emb(config, self.head_dim)
+        self.attn = Attention(
+            self.num_heads,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.scaling,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            per_layer_sliding_window=sliding_window,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn",
+            attn_type=AttentionType.DECODER,
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        q_shape, k_shape = q.shape, k.shape
+        q = self.q_norm(
+            q.view(*q_shape[:-1], q_shape[-1] // self.head_dim, self.head_dim)
+        ).view(q_shape)
+        k = self.k_norm(
+            k.view(*k_shape[:-1], k_shape[-1] // self.head_dim, self.head_dim)
+        ).view(k_shape)
+        q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q, k)
+        attn_output = self.attn(q, k, v)
+        output, _ = self.o_proj(attn_output)
+        return output
+

+class MiniMaxM3DSparkDecoderLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Any,
+        *,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+        sliding_window: int | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        rms_eps = getattr(config, "rms_norm_eps", 1e-6)
+        ffn_size = int(
+            _cfg_get(
+                config,
+                "dspark_ffn_hidden_size",
+                "dense_intermediate_size",
+                default=config.intermediate_size,
+            )
+        )
+        self.self_attn = MiniMaxM3DSparkAttention(
+            config,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.self_attn",
+            sliding_window=sliding_window,
+        )
+        self.mlp = MiniMaxM3DSparkMLP(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            ffn_size,
+            swiglu_limit=float(getattr(config, "swiglu_limit", 7.0)),
+            swiglu_alpha=float(getattr(config, "swiglu_alpha", 1.702)),
+            swiglu_beta=float(getattr(config, "swiglu_beta", 1.0)),
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.mlp",
+        )
+        self.input_layernorm = GemmaRMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=rms_eps)
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = GemmaRMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=rms_eps)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if residual is not None:
+            hidden_states, residual = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states, residual)
+        else:
+            residual = hidden_states
+            hidden_states = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states)
+        hidden_states = self.self_attn(positions=positions, hidden_states=hidden_states)
+        hidden_states, residual = self.post_attention_layernorm(hidden_states, residual)
+        hidden_states = self.mlp(hidden_states)
+        return hidden_states, residual

+    def _build_fused_kv_buffers(self) -> None:

+    def precompute_and_store_context_kv(

+        context_slot_mapping: torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor | None] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Gemma-norm KV precompute with MiniMax partial RoPE."""
+        if not hasattr(self, "_num_attn_layers"):

+                "MiniMax DSpark buffer initialization was skipped. If dummy "
+                "weights are not in use, this may indicate an error in weight "
+                "loading."

+            self._build_fused_kv_buffers()

+        num_ctx = context_states.shape[0]
+        layers = self._num_attn_layers
+        head_dim = self._head_dim
+        num_kv_heads = self._num_kv_heads
+        all_k, all_v = self._project_context_kv(
+            context_states, num_ctx, layers, num_kv_heads, head_dim
+        )
+        all_k_normed = self._normalize_context_k(all_k)
+        if context_slot_mapping is None:
+            return
+        per_layer = isinstance(context_slot_mapping, (list, tuple))
+        for i, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
+            slot_mapping = (
+                context_slot_mapping[i] if per_layer else context_slot_mapping
+            )
+            if slot_mapping is None:
+                continue
+            k = all_k_normed[i].reshape(num_ctx, num_kv_heads * head_dim)
+            dummy_q = k
+            _, k = layer.self_attn.rotary_emb(context_positions, dummy_q, k)
+            attn = self._attn_layers[i]
+            attn.impl.do_kv_cache_update(
+                attn,
+                k.view(num_ctx, num_kv_heads, head_dim),
+                all_v[i],
+                attn.kv_cache,
+                slot_mapping,
+            )

+"""MiniMax-M3.1 nested DSpark checkpoint name mapping.
+
+Official ``DSparkMiniMaxDraftModel`` shards live under
+``language_model.model.dspark.layers.{i}.decoder_layer.*``. vLLM's draft module
+expects ``layers.{i}.*`` with fused qkv / gate_up projections and ModelOpt
+``weight_scale`` (not ``weight_scale_inv``).
+
+This module is importable without the rest of vLLM so CPU tests can lock the
+mapping independently of Attention / msgspec / uvloop.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import regex as re
+
+DSPARK_ORIG_TO_NEW_REGEX: dict[re.Pattern[str], str] = {
+    re.compile(r"^language_model\.model\.dspark\."): "",
+    re.compile(r"\.decoder_layer\."): ".",
+    re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])final_norm(?=\.|$)"): "norm",
+    re.compile(r"weight_scale_inv"): "weight_scale",
+}
+
+DSPARK_ORIG_TO_NEW_STACKED: dict[str, tuple[str, str | int]] = {
+    ".q_proj": (".qkv_proj", "q"),
+    ".k_proj": (".qkv_proj", "k"),
+    ".v_proj": (".qkv_proj", "v"),
+    ".gate_proj": (".gate_up_proj", 0),
+    ".up_proj": (".gate_up_proj", 1),
+}
+
+
+def map_dspark_weight_name(name: str) -> tuple[str, str | int | None] | None:
+    """Map one official DSpark tensor name to the vLLM draft parameter.
+
+    Returns ``(mapped_name, shard_id)``. ``shard_id`` is set for stacked q/k/v
+    and gate/up weights.
+    """
+    mapped = name
+    for pattern, replacement in DSPARK_ORIG_TO_NEW_REGEX.items():
+        mapped = pattern.sub(replacement, mapped)
+
+    shard_id: str | int | None = None
+    for substr, (new_substr, new_shard_id) in DSPARK_ORIG_TO_NEW_STACKED.items():
+        if substr in mapped:
+            mapped = mapped.replace(substr, new_substr, 1)
+            shard_id = new_shard_id
+            break
+    return mapped, shard_id

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""NVFP4→MXFP4 routed-expert layout used by the MiniMax-M3.1 AMD recipe.
+
+The official MiniMax-M3.1 checkpoint stores routed experts as ModelOpt NVFP4
+(``w1`` gate / ``w3`` up / ``w2`` down). On ROCm those experts are dequantized,
+padded to the AITER MXFP4 tile, and requantized online to MXFP4
+(``--quantization-config.moe mxfp4``). This module documents the layout so CPU
+tests can lock scales, padding, packing, and tensor names without loading the
+MoE kernels.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+NVFP4_GROUP_SIZE = 16
+MXFP4_GROUP_SIZE = 32
+FP4_PACK_FACTOR = 2
+# Generic ROCm AITER MXFP4 (W4A16 / Triton) alignment. W4A4 uses 256 for hidden
+# and 128 for intermediate; the AMD MiniMax recipe does not pin W4A4.
+ROCM_AITER_MXFP4_ALIGN = 256
+
+# Checkpoint expert names consumed by ``fused_moe_make_expert_params_mapping``.
+MINIMAX_ROUTED_EXPERT_CKPT = {
+    "gate": "w1",
+    "down": "w2",
+    "up": "w3",
+}
+
+# ModelOpt NVFP4 tensors on each routed expert. ``weight_scale_inv`` is remapped
+# to ``weight_scale`` during MiniMax ``load_weights``.
+MINIMAX_NVFP4_EXPERT_TENSORS = (
+    "weight",
+    "weight_scale",
+    "weight_scale_2",
+    "input_scale",
+)
+
+
+def round_up(value: int, alignment: int) -> int:
+    """Smallest multiple of ``alignment`` that is >= ``value``."""
+    if alignment <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"alignment must be positive, got {alignment}")
+    return (value + alignment - 1) // alignment * alignment
+
+
+def nvfp4_packed_cols(cols: int) -> int:
+    """NVFP4 packs two e2m1 values per byte along the reduction dimension."""
+    if cols % FP4_PACK_FACTOR != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"NVFP4 cols must be even, got {cols}")
+    return cols // FP4_PACK_FACTOR
+
+
+def nvfp4_scale_cols(cols: int) -> int:
+    """FP8 per-group scales: one scale per NVFP4 group of 16 elements."""
+    if cols % NVFP4_GROUP_SIZE != 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"NVFP4 cols must be divisible by {NVFP4_GROUP_SIZE}, got {cols}"
+        )
+    return cols // NVFP4_GROUP_SIZE
+
+
+def mxfp4_packed_cols(cols: int) -> int:
+    """MXFP4 packs two e2m1 values per byte along the reduction dimension."""
+    if cols % FP4_PACK_FACTOR != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"MXFP4 cols must be even, got {cols}")
+    return cols // FP4_PACK_FACTOR
+
+
+def mxfp4_scale_cols(cols: int) -> int:
+    """e8m0 per-block scales: one scale per MXFP4 group of 32 elements."""
+    if cols % MXFP4_GROUP_SIZE != 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"MXFP4 cols must be divisible by {MXFP4_GROUP_SIZE}, got {cols}"
+        )
+    return cols // MXFP4_GROUP_SIZE
+
+
+def aiter_mxfp4_padded_dims(
+    hidden_size: int,
+    intermediate_size: int,
+    *,
+    alignment: int = ROCM_AITER_MXFP4_ALIGN,
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Pad hidden / intermediate to the AITER MXFP4 tile used on ROCm."""
+    return round_up(hidden_size, alignment), round_up(intermediate_size, alignment)
+
+
+def fused_w13_shape(
+    num_experts: int,
+    intermediate_size: int,
+    hidden_size: int,
+    *,
+    num_shards: int = 2,
+) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """Fused gate+up weight: ``[E, num_shards * I, H]`` (gate=0, up=1)."""
+    return (num_experts, num_shards * intermediate_size, hidden_size)
+
+
+def down_w2_shape(
+    num_experts: int, hidden_size: int, intermediate_size: int
+) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """Down-projection weight: ``[E, H, I]``."""
+    return (num_experts, hidden_size, intermediate_size)
+
+
+def pad_fused_expert_shapes(
+    num_experts: int,
+    hidden_size: int,
+    intermediate_size: int,
+    *,
+    num_shards: int = 2,
+    alignment: int = ROCM_AITER_MXFP4_ALIGN,
+) -> tuple[tuple[int, int, int], tuple[int, int, int]]:
+    """Source and padded ``(w13, w2)`` shapes after AITER alignment."""
+    padded_h, padded_i = aiter_mxfp4_padded_dims(
+        hidden_size, intermediate_size, alignment=alignment
+    )
+    return (
+        fused_w13_shape(num_experts, padded_i, padded_h, num_shards=num_shards),
+        down_w2_shape(num_experts, padded_h, padded_i),
+    )
+
+
+def copy_padded_w13_w2(
+    w13: list[list[list[float]]],
+    w2: list[list[list[float]]],
+    *,
+    target_hidden: int,
+    target_intermediate: int,
+    num_shards: int = 2,
+) -> tuple[list[list[list[float]]], list[list[list[float]]]]:
+    """Zero-pad fused w13 / w2 like online MXFP4 requantization.
+
+    Each gate/up shard is copied independently so NVFP4 w1/w3 scales stay
+    associated with the matching half of w13 after padding.
+    """
+    num_experts = len(w13)
+    src_intermediate = len(w13[0]) // num_shards
+    src_hidden = len(w13[0][0])
+    padded_w13 = [
+        [[0.0] * target_hidden for _ in range(num_shards * target_intermediate)]
+        for _ in range(num_experts)
+    ]
+    padded_w2 = [
+        [[0.0] * target_intermediate for _ in range(target_hidden)]
+        for _ in range(num_experts)
+    ]
+    for expert in range(num_experts):
+        for shard in range(num_shards):
+            src_start = shard * src_intermediate
+            dst_start = shard * target_intermediate
+            for row in range(src_intermediate):
+                padded_w13[expert][dst_start + row][:src_hidden] = w13[expert][
+                    src_start + row
+                ]
+        for row in range(src_hidden):
+            padded_w2[expert][row][:src_intermediate] = w2[expert][row]
+    return padded_w13, padded_w2
+
+
+def split_gate_up_rows(w13_rows: int, *, num_shards: int = 2) -> tuple[range, range]:
+    """Row ranges of fused w13 that belong to gate (w1) and up (w3)."""
+    if w13_rows % num_shards != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"w13 rows {w13_rows} are not divisible by {num_shards}")
+    intermediate = w13_rows // num_shards
+    return range(0, intermediate), range(intermediate, 2 * intermediate)

+"""ROCm MiniMax-M3.1 serving constraints and the AMD compatibility recipe.
+
+CDNA4 has no native NVFP4 KV/indexer kernels. The supported AMD path loads the
+official MiniMax-M3.1 NVFP4 checkpoint, requantizes routed experts to MXFP4,
+and keeps the existing FP8 MSA/indexer caches.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Literal
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+RocmIndexerKVDType = Literal["bf16", "fp8"]
+
+ROCM_DEFAULT_INDEXER_KV_DTYPE: RocmIndexerKVDType = "fp8"
+
+MINIMAX_DSPARK_ARCHITECTURES = (
+    "DSparkMiniMaxDraftModel",
+    "MiniMaxM3DSparkModel",
+)
+
+MINIMAX_M31_ROCM_RECIPE = (
+    "--kv-cache-dtype fp8 "
+    '--attention-config \'{"indexer_kv_dtype": "fp8"}\' '
+    "--quantization-config.moe mxfp4"
+)
+
+
+def default_minimax_indexer_kv_dtype() -> RocmIndexerKVDType:
+    """Indexer cache dtype when ``attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype`` is auto.
+
+    MI350/MI355 (gfx950) MSA indexer is fp8 MFMA, so those GPUs default to
+    fp8. Other platforms keep bf16 unless the user overrides it.
+    """
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return "bf16"
+    try:
+        from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+    except ImportError:
+        return "bf16"
+    return ROCM_DEFAULT_INDEXER_KV_DTYPE if on_gfx950() else "bf16"
+
+
+def is_minimax_draft_weight(name: str) -> bool:
+    """True for MiniMax MTP or nested DSpark tensors the target model skips."""
+    return "mtp." in name or "dspark." in name
+
+
+def minimax_m31_rocm_nvfp4_unsupported(kind: str) -> str:
+    """User-facing error for NVFP4 caches that ROCm MiniMax cannot serve."""
+    return (
+        f"MiniMax-M3.1 {kind} is not supported on ROCm. "
+        f"Serve the official NVFP4 checkpoint with {MINIMAX_M31_ROCM_RECIPE}. "
+        "That requantizes routed experts NVFP4→MXFP4 at load and keeps the "
+        "supported FP8 MSA/indexer path."
+    )
+
+
+def is_minimax_m3_hf_config(hf_config: Any) -> bool:
+    """True when ``hf_config`` is a MiniMax-M3 / M3.1 text or VL config."""
+    model_type = str(getattr(hf_config, "model_type", "") or "")
+    if model_type in (
+        "minimax_m3",
+        "minimax_m3_text",
+        "minimax_m3_vl",
+        "minimax_m3_mtp",
+    ):
+        return True
+    text = getattr(hf_config, "text_config", None)
+    return str(getattr(text, "model_type", "") or "") in (
+        "minimax_m3",
+        "minimax_m3_text",
+    )
+
+
+def minimax_m3_sparse_attention_is_full(hf_config: Any) -> bool:
+    """True when every layer uses MSA (MiniMax-M3.1), not mixed dense+MSA (M3)."""
+    text = hf_config
+    getter = getattr(hf_config, "get_text_config", None)
+    if callable(getter):
+        text = getter()
+    elif getattr(hf_config, "text_config", None) is not None:
+        text = hf_config.text_config
+    cfg = getattr(text, "sparse_attention_config", None) or {}
+    freq = cfg.get("sparse_attention_freq")
+    return bool(freq) and all(int(flag) != 0 for flag in freq)
+
+
+def nested_minimax_dspark_model(target_model: str, hf_config: Any) -> str | None:
+    """Return MiniMax-M3.1's nested DSpark draft path when one exists.
+
+    Official MiniMax-M3.1 checkpoints ship the DSpark drafter under
+    ``{model}/dspark/`` rather than as a sibling Hugging Face repo. Prefer a
+    local ``dspark/config.json``; fall back to the Hub subpath when every
+    layer is MSA (the M3.1 layout). MiniMax-M3 keeps MTP modules in the
+    target weights, so it must not take this path.
+
+    Keep this policy in sync with
+    ``vllm.config.speculative._minimax_m3_nested_dspark_model``.
+    """
+    if not target_model:
+        return None
+    local = Path(target_model) / "dspark"
+    if (local / "config.json").is_file():
+        return str(local)
+    if not is_minimax_m3_hf_config(hf_config):
+        return None
+    if minimax_m3_sparse_attention_is_full(hf_config):
+        return f"{str(target_model).rstrip('/')}/dspark"
+    return None
+
+
+def preserves_minimax_dspark_architecture(architectures: Any) -> bool:
+    """True when HF config rewrite must keep the nested MiniMax DSpark arch."""
+    if not architectures:
+        return False
+    return str(architectures[0]) in MINIMAX_DSPARK_ARCHITECTURES
